title: pyrrosia gardneri
intro: Pyrrosia gardneri, commonly known as the Chinese shield fern, is a species of plant in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a type of medicinal plant traditionally used in Chinese medicine to promote health and well-being. The health benefits of Pyrrosia gardneri include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and inhibit the growth of cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and antimicrobial effects.
